**q25.**
Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) — internal/filter/engine.go:16-34 (`Engine`, `NewEngine`, `DefaultEngine`).
Mechanism: A filter string is compiled by the CEL environment into an AST/expr (engine.go:53-57), converted into a dialect-agnostic `Condition` tree by `buildCondition` (engine.go:62), then each dialect's store code (store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61, store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58, store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69) calls `filter.AppendConditions` with its own `DialectName` (DialectSQLite/DialectPostgres/DialectMySQL) to render the tree into dialect-specific SQL fragments and args appended to the WHERE clause.

**q26.**
`memo`, `memo_relation`, `attachment` (attachments are deleted, which per store/attachment.go logic may also affect attachment-linked records) — derived from store/memo.go:140-159: memo_relation rows (source+target) and attachments linked to the memo are deleted before the `memo` row itself.

**q27.**
Mechanism: Go `embed.FS` embedding the built frontend `dist/*` directory, served via Echo static/file handlers.
File: server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21 (`//go:embed dist/*`, `var embeddedFiles embed.FS`), served via `fs.Sub` at frontend.go:116.

**q28.**

Unused infra note: `internal/scheduler` package (a generic cron-style job scheduler, internal/scheduler/doc.go) exists in the codebase but is referenced only from its own tests (example_test.go, integration_test.go) — it is not wired into server/server.go or any runner, i.e., not used at runtime. `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go) is called synchronously from request handlers (memo_service.go:108,447), not started as a background runner.

Tokens managed: short-lived JWT access token (kept in memory, refreshed proactively/reactively) and a refresh token (handled via `authServiceClient.refreshToken`/cookie-based, web/src/connect.ts:65-82).
Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`Authenticator`, server/auth/authenticator.go:17-40; JWT access tokens and Personal Access Tokens, per authenticator.go:20-23).

- memo comment created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:30

All converge on `webhook.PostAsync` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:184 (which enqueues to `internal/webhook/webhook.go`'s async queue, ultimately delivered by `Post` at webhook.go:120).
